name: MediKiosk-Backend
description: FastAPI healthcare intake backend for SIH26 MediTrack (ABDM, Bhashini, AYUSH, DPDP Act 2023).

DATABASE_URL.description: asyncpg URL. Heroku Postgres exposes postgres://; rewrite to postgresql+asyncpg://.

FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: 32-byte urlsafe-base64 key for Aadhaar/ABHA field encryption.

PII_LOOKUP_HMAC_KEY.description: 32-byte urlsafe-base64 HMAC key for blind PII lookups.
